reviewer: Codex child /root/modeling_provider, independent of builder implementation
source_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; LF verified before review and after tests
scope: Read-only audit of the fixed Blender v2 interpreter and its tests; no changes to builder, old v1 files, or historical public evidence.
verified_design: Closed top-level/material/region/surface/finish/completion JSON object fields; bounded finite numeric inputs; no model-provided script, operator name, path, module import, eval or executable code.

Data selects only box/ellipsoid/capsule/cylinder/loft/cage; lofts use complete capped cross sections and transported frames; cage indices, duplicate faces, edge incidence and connected vertex fans are checked before Blender execution.
Each original region is independently checked for one connected closed manifold, finite coordinates, positive signed volume and no degenerate triangles before fusion.
Body regions are joined and voxel fused with use_remove_disconnected=False. A multi-component body is refused; no largest-component selection or component deletion path exists.

Face normals are recalculated and globally reversed when signed volume is negative. Body connectivity/manifold/positive-volume checks are repeated after remesh and final smoothing/subdivision/triangulation.
Every final body/accessory is separately checked for one component, edge-and-vertex manifold topology, positive volume and zero degenerate triangles; exported geometry totals are measured.
Fixed Blender startup/disable-autoexec is a host responsibility and is used by the real tests. The interpreter creates fresh data and never opens a model-supplied blend file.

explicit_cleanup.operations: After modifiers, remove_doubles and dissolve_degenerate use tolerance=min(voxel_size*0.00001,0.000001) metres; triangulation then follows.
explicit_cleanup.disclosure: Raw output receipt records per-object tolerance, merged_vertices and dissolved_faces in cleanup[]; this is explicit sub-micrometre numerical cleanup, not anatomical/component removal.
explicit_cleanup.final_gate: Topology/connectedness/volume/degenerate-triangle checks run again after cleanup and must pass; cleanup cannot make a disconnected body silently succeed.

budgets.enforcement: Voxel bounding-grid budget is checked before remesh. Conservative polygon/subdivision estimates gate modifiers; actual final triangle count is checked before export. A host process deadline is still required for intermediate Blender work.

checks: actual output GLB sha256 and bytes
raw_receipt.render_paths: When explicitly requested, only five fixed sibling file names are emitted; model data cannot choose render paths.

independent_tests.command: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tools/ainative -p test_sculpt_builder.py -v
independent_tests.environment: AINATIVE_TEST_BLENDER set to the existing local Blender executable; no download or online model calls.
real_blender_cases: three overlapping loft branches fuse to one closed manifold body with positive volume and complete front/back depth
detached body fails without component filtering or publication
oversized voxel grid refused before remesh
five fixed CPU workbench PNG views created
data_validation_cases: pinched vertex rejected despite two-face edge incidence
empty body and zero-length loft path rejected
independent_tests.render_validation_limit: Automated test verifies five fixed PNG artifacts; this review did not perform visual quality acceptance of rendered characters.

material_limits_and_remaining_acceptance: Topological manifold/positive volume and complete geometry do not prove anatomical quality, reference likeness, semantic completeness, multiview consistency or exact hidden-surface recovery.
No explicit geometric self-intersection detector or animation retopology/UV/rig validation is claimed. These outputs are closed sculpt surfaces.

Actual GPT full stylized character, organic-object and image hidden-surface completion tests, native node preview/publication/reopen, visual review and final candidate checks remain root acceptance work.
conclusion: No blocking defect found in the reviewed fixed-interpreter contract. Approve this builder for expanded real business acceptance; do not treat synthetic builder tests as completion of Issue543.
